name: Fiat 500 (312)
note: Values are the pre-facelift body (2007–2015). The 2015–2024 facelift is L 3571 (+25 mm in the bumpers; W/H/wb unchanged, tracks 1413/1407) and its overhang split is not published. L/W/H/wb/tracks: auto-data.net, autotijd and l'argus agree; L/W/wb also match the official FCA US 2012 spec sheet for the US-market 500 (3546.7/1627/2300). fo/ro: single source (l'argus 2012 fiche, 703+2300+543=3546). Wm 1893: autotijd + auto-data.net (facelift pages). Roof type varies by trim (Lounge trims had a fixed glass roof; from general knowledge, not checked against a source here), so no roof tag is set.

name: Toyota Yaris (XP210)
note: All values incl. overhangs from Toyota GB media tech-spec sheets (2021 and 2025 sheets agree; European body, not the narrower 1695 mm Japanese Yaris). Tracks 1518/1514 are the 2021 sheet (16/17-inch wheels); the 2025 sheet gives ranges 1521–1531 / 1518–1528. Width incl. mirrors is not published by Toyota.

name: Škoda Fabia IV
note: L/W/H/wb/tracks: Škoda technical-data PDF. fo/ro and Wm are not in Škoda's sheet; autotijd, auto-data.net and l'argus all give 809/735 and 1954 (two-sources level).

name: VW Golf 8 (5-door)
note: L/W/H/wb: VW press kit 2019 (archived newsroom page). INCONSISTENT between VW sources: VW's later data (VW UK dimensions page, aggregators) quote wb 2619/2620 and H 1491/1483 for the same body. fo/ro: single source (autotijd version page) and they only add up with wb 2636 (872+2636+776=4284), which is why the press-kit wheelbase is used. Tracks: auto-data.net + l'argus (1533/1504). Wm 2073: autotijd (single). 2024 facelift: L 4282.

name: Kia Ceed (CD) 5-door
note: All values incl. overhangs from the Kia 2018 launch press release. Official tracks are quoted on 15-inch wheels; on 16-inch (205/55 R16) aggregators give 1565/1573. Wm 2055: auto-data.net (single source for the hatchback; cars-data.com gives the same figure for the Sportswagon). The 2021 facelift is a few mm longer (l'argus lists 4.32 m).

name: Škoda Scala
note: L/W/H/wb/tracks: Škoda technical-data PDF (same for the 2019 launch car and the 2023 facelift). fo/ro and Wm: autotijd, auto-data.net and l'argus agree (two-sources level). 205/55 R16 is the other common tyre size.

name: Škoda Octavia IV liftback
note: Values are the 2024 facelift (Škoda technical data 2025). Pre-facelift 2020–2024: L 4689, same W/H/wb/tracks, fo 910 / ro 1094 per aggregators (sums to 4690, 1 mm rounding). fo/ro and Wm are not in Škoda's sheet: autotijd + l'argus agree (two-sources level).

name: Tesla Model 3 (Highland)
note: Tesla Model 3 Owner's Manual (EU edition), Rear-Wheel Drive / Long Range, read from an archived copy because tesla.com blocks scripted access. Width with mirrors folded 1933. Performance variant: L 4724, H 1431, fo 872, ro 978, tracks 1582/1560. Tyre size from l'argus (18-inch standard wheel).

name: Škoda Superb IV liftback
note: L/W/H/wb/tracks: Škoda technical-data PDF. fo/ro: autotijd + l'argus agree (two-sources level). Wm 2090: single source (autotijd). Tyre is the size l'argus lists for the L&K trim.

name: Kia Ceed Sportswagon (CD)
note: All values incl. overhangs from the Kia 2018 launch press release. Official tracks are quoted on 15-inch wheels. Wm 2055: auto-data.net + cars-data.com. cars-data.com wrongly lists rear overhang 780 for the SW (the hatchback value). autotijd lists L 4600–4605 across model years. Roof rails: listed as standard equipment (l'argus equipment list, base trim).

name: Škoda Octavia Combi IV
note: Values are the 2024 facelift (Škoda technical data 2025). Pre-facelift 2020–2024: L 4689, rear track 1535, fo 910 / ro 1094 per aggregators (sums to 4690, 1 mm rounding). fo/ro and Wm: autotijd + l'argus agree (two-sources level). Roof rails: in l'argus equipment lists for the 2025 trims (not listed for 2021 trims).

name: VW Passat Variant B9
note: L/W/H/wb and both overhangs from the VW press pack (International Media Drive 2024; side-view drawing 957 | 2,841 | 1,119). One paragraph of the same press pack says width 1,852; 1,849 is used (summary text and all aggregators). Wm and tracks: autotijd, auto-data.net and l'argus agree. This generation is estate-only.

name: Dacia Duster III
note: Dacia UK brochure dimension page (4x2 values) plus the Dacia UK Duster Cargo page. Official fo 857 + wb 2657 + ro 828 = 4342, 1 mm short of L, so ro is set to 829 to close the rounding gap. 4x4: H 1661, wb 2658, ro 827. H 1656 is with roof bars (1616 without). Width with mirrors folded 1921. Tracks as printed in the brochure drawing; other Dacia/aggregator figures differ slightly (front 1578, rear 1556). Higher trims run 17- and 18-inch wheels.

name: Škoda Kodiaq II
note: L/W/H/wb/tracks: Škoda technical data 2025 (5-seat; 7-seat is H 1658, rear track 1576). fo/ro: autotijd, auto-data.net and l'argus all give 927/1041, which sums to 4759; ro is reduced by 1 mm to 1040 so fo+wb+ro equals L. Wm 2133 (mirrors folded 1924): autotijd + auto-data.net.

name: BMW X5 (G05)
note: Values are the pre-LCI car 2018–2023 (BMW Media Information 6/2018, xDrive30d/40i). Rear overhang 1073 and Wm 2218 are from the BMW Canada product guide (the North American car is 4936 long with front overhang 888); European fo = 4922-2975-1073 = 874, confirmed by auto-data.net, l'argus and autotijd. LCI 2023–: L 4935, H 1765, fo 887 (autotijd). Base tyre on 30d/40i was 255/55 R18. Roof rails are standard in the BMW Canada guide (assumed the same for Europe).

name: VW Touran (5T)
note: L/W/H/wb: VW UK official dimensions page. Overhangs are NOT published by VW or by any aggregator checked (autotijd, auto-data.net, cars-data, l'argus), so fo/ro are null. Launch-era data (2015) quote wb 2791, H 1659 and tracks 1569/1542 for the same body. Wm and tracks: autotijd + auto-data.net. Roof rails: shown on VW's own dimension picture and in the l'argus equipment list (possibly not on base trims).

name: Dacia Jogger
note: Official Dacia 'Fiche technique Jogger 02/2023' dimension drawing (pre-facelift 2021–2025; 5- and 7-seat identical outside). The drawing gives height 1674/1691 depending on roof bars (auto-data.net and launch reports give 1632 without bars). Width with mirrors folded 1848. 2025 facelift per the current Dacia UK brochure: L 4550, wb 2898, Wm 2012.

name: VW Sharan II (7N)
note: L/W/Wm: VW press release 2015 (which also gives H 1713 without roof rails; 1720 with rails per autotijd/auto-data.net, cars-data says 1740). wb 2920 (2919 in 2010 data) and tracks: auto-data.net, cars-data and l'argus agree (two-sources level; autotijd differs with 1557/1603). Overhangs are NOT published by VW or any aggregator checked, so fo/ro are null. Rear doors are sliding.

name: Toyota Hilux double cab (AN120/130)
note: Toyota GB media tech-spec sheets 2022 and 2024 (double cab; Invincible X is W 1900 / H 1865). INCONSISTENT with older data: 2016–2020 figures (auto-data.net, l'argus) give L 5330–5335 with fo 1000 / ro 1250. Deck 1525 long x 1540 max wide x 480 deep. Width incl. mirrors is not published by Toyota.

name: Ford Ranger double cab (P703)
note: No official Ford spec sheet for the P703 could be retrieved (the ford.co.uk PDFs reachable were for the previous model). L, wb, front overhang and tracks agree across carsales/RedBook (AU), vanreviewer (UK), l'argus (FR) and auto-data.net. The published rear overhang is 1215, but 865+3270+1215 = 5350 (l'argus lists L 5.35 m; presumably the body without the rear step bumper); ro is set to 1235 (derived) so the sum equals the overall length 5370 incl. rear bumper. W 1918 is single-source (carsales); width with mirrors folded 2015. Bed size is UNVERIFIED: length 1564 (l'argus) vs 1464 (RedBook) vs 1638 (vanreviewer); width 1520 (RedBook), 1217–1224 between wheel arches.

name: RAM 1500 Crew Cab 5'7" box (DT)
note: Official Stellantis North America '2021 Ram 1500 Specifications' (Crew Cab, 5 ft 7 in box, 4x4; the 4x2 is H 1968). North American market model; cars in Europe are imports with the same body. Overhangs and width incl. mirrors are not in the spec sheet and no other source was found, so fo/ro/Wm are null. Box: 1711 long at floor with tailgate closed, 1687 wide, 1295 between wheelhouses, 543 deep.
